prior_receipts.detail: Read entire durable adapter and both historical v1 and current v2 replay paths. Applied JSON-only receipt/token/cost/reservation equations to every retained v1 run. Database comparison, injected observer replay, prompt regeneration, source imports and actual provider dispatch remain outside this audit.
Read compact UTF-8 canonicalization, SHA-256, write-once semantics and checkout/resource discovery. Only the declared v1 byte conventions were reproduced; write_once was never invoked.

Read per-stage decoding and max-output override, decimal price ceiling and timeout logic. Experiment reservations use ceiling(rate*hold*1e6), so applying the free-route reservation-zero rule to all v1 runs would be wrong; the final audit respects the recorded experiment profile.
